answer: Network latency multilateration deters Sybil attacks without confining agents to a walled garden. Distributed beacons measure packet transit across copper cabling to verify physical locations, yielding topological records as durable as jade. An attacker incurs the verifiable, scarce capital cost of leasing distinct physical network routes and hardware interfaces per identity. However, collusive proxy relays and artificial delays can spoof transit times to compromise coordinate accuracy.
